INFRARED SAUNA RELAYS

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

  • There are many things an infrared sauna owner needs and to obtain these things, an owner needs to have a reliable supplier.
  • Is your supplier constantly running out of parts because they said your sauna appliances are not available? This can be frustrating because it can interrupt your business.
  • Read on to learn more about a supplier that will be able to get you what you need when you need them.

At InfraredSaunaParts, we take pride in what we do. Being in the business for more than 15 years give us valuable experience and advantage in understanding what our customers want. We’re able to supply anything and everything that they need to ensure their infrared sauna business runs smoothly.

Among many things that we supply are electrical goods. Items such as thermostats, power boards, relays, and fuses are often in demand from infrared sauna business owners. Our electrical goods are certified and safety regulation compliant. We made sure they went through rigid testing and safety procedures before we distribute them to our customers.

We understand and are fully aware of the importance of having high quality electrical items to ensure the safety of your sauna and also your clients. This is why our electrical items are of top-notch grade and make. Like our relays, for instance. We have several types that you can choose from depending on the usage of your sauna.

Our customers can choose from thermal cooler or thermal silicone grease or a solid relay with reset buttons. If you’re not sure which one you need, you can give us a call to talk more about your sauna so we’re able to help you with the right choice.

At InfraredSaunaParts, we’re committed in making sure our customers get the best deal by helping them figure out what’s the best they need. You can browse through our catalogue and choose the things you need, or you can always speak to us for more details. If you have something that you need but can’t find it on our catalogue, let us know so we will help to get it for you.

Make the right decision by speaking to us today!
